_source: Synthetic, written 2026-10-11 from the PAD example in the EasyEDA format document (docs.easyeda.com/en/DocumentFormat/EasyEDA-Format-Standard, read 2026-10-11): `PAD~ELLIPSE~4020~3308.5~6~6~11~~1~1.8~~0~gge5~0~~Y~0~~~4020,3308.5`, whose twentieth field, holeCenter, states the pad's centre again. Three 2.00 x 3.00mm pads with a 0.80mm hole, 2.54mm apart. Pad 1: holeCenter moved 0.5mm right and 0.5mm down the sheet from the pad's centre (EasyEDA's y grows downwards). Pad 2: the same, with the pad turned 90 degrees. Pad 3: the hole in the middle, which is the control.
